d1.req_text: The schedule always shows all technicians' shifts and events for every user who has Schedule: View. There is no role-based restriction to "own shifts only." This is intentional: the schedule is a shared coordination resource that service advisors and managers use to orchestrate work across the team. The "My Shifts" toggle in the Filter and Display dropdown (§9) provides this as an optional personal convenience filter, not a security boundary.
